reason: The NAAMP national protocol states that Gulf Coast and Great Plains routes should have been conducted within three days of rainfall. This sensitivity asks whether the existing RC7 footprint/alpha/gamma associations remain when rainfall contrast extends beyond that protocol-target window.
model: response ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber), route-clustered covariance

primary_crosses_three_day_window.meaning: At least the drier member lies outside the protocol-target 0-3 day post-rain window.
primary_crosses_three_day_window.pass_rule: All three rainfall-contrast coefficients are positive.
primary_crosses_three_day_window.strong_pass_rule: All three 95% confidence intervals are entirely above zero.

secondary_both_outside_three_day_window.meaning: Both members lie outside the protocol-target 0-3 day post-rain window.
secondary_both_outside_three_day_window.decision_role: descriptive diagnostic only; report n, slopes and confidence intervals without a PASS requirement because this subset may remove the biologically strongest immediate-rain contrasts.

authorized_interpretation.primary_pass: The multiscale association is not confined to comparisons entirely within the 0-3 day protocol-target window.
authorized_interpretation.primary_strong_pass: The footprint, alpha and gamma associations remain confidence-interval positive when the drier survey lies outside the 0-3 day protocol-target window.
authorized_interpretation.primary_fail: The pooled RC7 association remains the headline, but evidence outside the protocol-target window is insufficient or directionally inconsistent.

prohibited: the sensitivity identifies which states followed the rainfall-targeting protocol
a failed both-outside diagnostic invalidates the primary matched result
